Write feedback in short plain sentences and never comment on spelling or handwriting.

Question 12(a) [2 marks]: Outline the importance of customer service for this business.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
Magic Mowers Pty Ltd is an Australian manufacturing business that produces lawn mowers. These lawn mowers are then supplied to retail outlets.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 2):
2 marks: Sketches in general terms the importance of customer service for this business
1 marks: Names and recognises some aspects of the importance of customer service for this business

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Customer service is the actual service provided by the business to their customers. For this business it is important for the manufacturer to have high customer service to allow the retail customers to have the necessary information to be able to give customers information about the Magic Mower products.


TEACHER MARKER COMMENTS:
Students did not read the stimulus properly and identify that the lawn mower company needed to provide customer service to the retail outlets. This stopped many students receiving 2/2.
